answer: VDF timing proofs gate every identity: each node must compute a sequential squaring chain at registration, verified against a beacon seed. Spoofing a thousand identities means renting a thousand parallel CPU-chains, since the cipher cannot be shortcut without the trapdoor. Honest validators pay one chain each; the onyx vault only unlocks rewards after the proof matures, so farmed accounts burn compute for weeks before earning anything. Cost scales linearly with identity count while rewards stay capped — the attacker's margin dies before saturation. This works because VDFs make identity.
